_comment: Expected results after checking each disputed DeepSeek case against docxtpl 0.20.2 (see docs/decisions.md D58-D70). Keys override docs/eval/adversarial_cases.json.

nested_loops_nested_tables.adjudication: E1: docxtpl raises (tr open+close in one row = DTL206); 'x' in the {%tr for%} row is dropped (DTL209, E2)

filter_with_percent_in_p_tag.adjudication: {%p if%}x{%p endif%} in one paragraph raises 'unknown tag endif' (DTL210, new in 1.1)

smart_quotes_in_tag.adjudication: docxtpl replaces smart quotes inside tags; renders ok

dtl209_whitespace_only_neighbour_nbsp.adjudication: only a no-break space is dropped: invisible, not reported (DeepSeek agreed)

tr_prefix_mismatch.adjudication: 'x' and 'z' share rows with the loop tags and are dropped with them (E2)

tr_block_spans_two_tables.adjudication: 'a'/'b' in the {%tr%} rows are dropped with the rows (E2)

nested_table_location.adjudication: rendered: the whole table disappears, 'outer'/'inner' are lost (experiment E6)

infer_nested_loop_paths.adjudication: parent paths are the array/object nodes of the contract (by design, agreed)

dtl209_tc_cell_neighbour.adjudication: E3: tc block across rows corrupts the table (DTL207); 'extra' lost

schema_loop_over_number.adjudication: harness ran it with --data, where DTL303 is the right rule
